This is the second half of the same historical bug; the first half (whole-word category-trigger match) is covered by substring_trap_gitnexus_vs_git_category above. Uses a RESTRICTED binding with a large tool list so a real relevance filter actually runs (small/unrestricted lists short-circuit to 'keep everything').

cases.description: Regression lock for the 2026-09-01 Unified Hybrid Search (RRF) feature: when the task's string-channel matches MORE than 5 tools for an UNRESTRICTED binding (allowed_tools empty) and no BM25/embedding signal is configured (the actual production configuration -- core/spawner.go's NewToolRouter never wires up BM25Corpus/EmbedClient), the router must not silently cap the result to an arbitrary top-5 subset with non-deterministic tie-breaking. Uses direct tool-name substring matches (isRelevant rule 1) so all 8 available tools match the string channel deterministically, independent of the affinity-keyword map.

cases.description: Locks rank-fusion tie handling (regression found 2026-10-19). The task names a service whose tools all share the prefix token 'billing', so the lexical matcher scores the whole family identically. A rank-based fusion must not convert a channel with no ordering information into an alphabetical ordering: if it does, the alphabetically early members consume the whole schema budget and the tool carrying the task's action verb is never offered. A missed tool is unrecoverable by anything the model does (docs/architecture/ROUTING_DIAG.md), so this is critical. The budget is deliberately tight so the assertion is about ranking, not about the fixture fitting in the budget at all.
cases.task: In the billing service, void the bill

assertions.note: The only member carrying the action verb; sorts last by name.
